title: Skunk Works advisors to Secret Machines

tellings.quote: Other senior Skunk Works figures, Robert Weiss, Steve Justice, and Eric Schrock, along with Air Force Research Lab Commander Neil McCaslin, all advised Tom DeLonge and Peter Levenda's Secret Machines project.

plain: Around 2016, senior figures from Skunk Works, Lockheed's secret aircraft design division, named as Robert Weiss, Steve Justice and Eric Schrock, together with Neil McCasland, a commander of the Air Force Research Laboratory, advised Tom DeLonge and Peter Levenda on Sekret Machines, their book series about UFOs. Michels says this himself without naming a source. He raises it because it would tie senior defense insiders to a popular UFO project.
